newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower on CBOT, stronger yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower on CBOT, stronger yen.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Monday, reflecting the CBOT corn market's price losses on Friday and the stronger yen against the dollar, local traders said.
Prices were 30 to 130 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 30 yen at 14,130 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 24,946 lots.
Light selling from local investors pushed down the market from the opening session, traders said. But trading was basically thin, as Japanese investors could not find clear direction, they said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.68-1/2 per bushel at 0800 GMT, compared with Friday's closing price of $2.69-1/2.
The spot November contract of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.97 at 0800 GMT, down from Friday's closing price of $6.99.
